z-m-37-06.title: Saiti nawa ne ke akwai waɗanda 'sun ƙunshi 1 ko ba su ƙunshi 6 ba'?
z-m-37-06.topic: Hanyoyi biyu na ƙirga saitunan ƙarƙashin sharadi
z-m-37-06.goal: Raba sharadin bisa ko an haɗa abubuwa domin ƙirga saituna, sannan ka bincika ta kwatanta 'ƙirgawa kai tsaye' da 'cirewa daga jimillar'.
z-m-37-06.material: Yi la'akari da ƙananan saituna X na saitin duniya U={1,2,3,4,5,6} (saitin fanko da U kansa su ma ƙananan saituna ne). Akwai saituna 64 gaba ɗaya a U.
z-m-37-06.thinking.0: Mayar da sharadi zuwa zaɓi ga kowane abu
z-m-37-06.thinking.1: Ƙirga sharadin 'ko' ta hanyoyi da dama
z-m-37-06.thinking.2: Kwatanta sakamakon don tabbatar da juna
z-m-37-06.prereq.1: Ma'anar ƙaramin rukuni, da dalilin da ya sa ƙungiya mai abubuwa n take da ƙananan rukuni 2ⁿ (ga kowane abu, zaɓi ko a saka shi ko a'a)
z-m-37-06.s.s1.prompt: Ƙananan rukuni X nawa ne suke da '1 yana cikin X kuma 6 ba ya cikin X'?
z-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ƙirga adadin abubuwan da dole ne ka yanke shawarar 'a saka/ba a saka' a kansu.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da ƙa'idar ninkawa ga sauran abubuwan, ban da waɗanda aka riga aka yanke shawara a kansu.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka fahimci cewa kana yanke shawarar ko za a saka kowane ɗaya daga cikin abubuwa 4 da suka rage bayan cire biyun da aka riga aka yanke shawara a kansu.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.b: Wannan daidai yake da ƙidayar da ake yi idan abu guda ne kawai aka yanke shawara a kansa. Ka sake ƙirga adadin abubuwan da aka yanke shawara a kansu.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka ƙirga abubuwa da yawa a matsayin waɗanda aka riga aka yanke shawara a kansu ko kuma ka yi kuskure wajen ƙirga sauran. Ka sake duba adadin abubuwan da za a iya zaɓa cikin 'yanci.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.r.d: Yayin ƙirga yanayi ta hanyar ninkawa, ka yi kuskure wajen ƙidayar zaɓuɓɓuka. Ga kowane abu, zaɓuɓɓuka biyu ne: 'a saka/ba a saka'.
z-m-37-06.s.s1.explain: An riga an yanke shawarar saka 1 da barin 6 a waje, sauran 2, 3, 4, 5 kuma kowannensu za a iya sakawa ko a'a, saboda haka 2⁴=16.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.prompt: Canja sharadin. Ƙananan rukuni X nawa ne suke da '1 yana cikin X ko 6 ba ya cikin X'? ('Ko' ya haɗa da yanayin da aka cika sharuddan duka biyun, ba ɗaya kawai ba.)
z-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko, ka rubuta yadda ƙananan rukunin da ba su cika sharadin suke kasancewa.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.1: Raba zuwa yanayin da 1 yake ciki da wanda ba ya ciki, sannan ka ƙirga kowane yanayi.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.a: Ka yi amfani da amsar tambayar baya. Saboda akwai 'ko', ƙananan rukuni X da yawa sun cika sharadin.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.b: Wannan daidai yake da ƙirga yanayin '1 yana ciki' kawai. An bar yanayin da 1 ba ya ciki kuma 6 ma ba ya ciki.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.c: Ka ɗauka cewa duk ƙananan rukuni sun cika sharadin. Yaya game da X marar 1 amma mai 6?
z-m-37-06.s.s2.r.d: Ka yi kyau wajen nuna cewa ana samun ƙima iri ɗaya ko ka ɗauki 'ko' a matsayin cire yanayin da bai cika sharadin daga jimilla ko raba yanayi ka tara su.
z-m-37-06.s.s2.explain: Idan aka cire daga jimillar 64 yanayin da bai cika sharadin ba, wato X da '1 ba ya ciki kuma 6 yana ciki' (2⁴=16), za a sami 48. Ƙirga kai tsaye ma tana ba da haka: X 32 inda 1 yake ciki, da X 16 inda 1 ba ya ciki kuma 6 ma ba ya ciki; jimilla 48.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.prompt: Kana son tabbatar da cewa ka sami amsar s2 ta hanyoyi biyu. Zaɓi ko hanyar ƙirga kai tsaye ko hanyar cirewa daga jimilla ka bayyana ta, sannan ka tabbatar a layi ɗaya ko ɗayar hanyar tana ba da ƙima iri ɗaya.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi hanya guda ka rubuta, kana ba yanayin suna, waɗanne yanayi take ƙirgawa.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ka kwatanta da lambobi don ganin ko ɗayar hanyar ma tana ba da ƙidaya iri ɗaya.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Daga jimillar 64, a cire yanayi ...; sakamakon ... ne.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A cikin hanyoyin biyun, shin ƙananan rukunin da aka ƙirga sun haɗu da juna ko an bar wasu a waje?
z-m-37-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na yi amfani da dalilin da ya sa ƙarfin 2 ya bayyana a bayanina (zaɓin kowane abu)?
z-m-37-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Na tabbatar da cewa sakamakon hanyoyin biyun ya yi daidai?
z-m-37-06.s.s3.model.0: Daga ƙananan rukuni 64, a cire yanayi 16 na 'babu 1 kuma akwai 6', za a sami 48. Ƙirga kai tsaye ma tana ba da haka: 32 masu 1 da 16 marasa 1 da marasa 6, jimilla 48.
z-m-37-06.s.s3.model.1: Idan 1 yana ciki, sauran abubuwa 5 suna da 'yanci, don haka akwai 32; idan 1 ba ya ciki, dole ne a bar 6 a waje, don haka a zaɓi sauran 4, wato 16. Jimillar ita ce 48, kuma 64−16 ma 48 ne.

z-m-37-12.title: Shin “idan A⊂B kuma B⊄C, to A⊄C” gaskiya ne koyaushe?
z-m-37-12.topic: Bincika ko dangantakar haɗuwa ta kayyade ƙarshe (jadawalin kasancewa cikin rukuni uku)
z-m-37-12.goal: Yanke hukunci ko iƙirarin haɗuwa yana aiki koyaushe ta hanyar ƙirƙirar misali mai karyatawa da jadawalin kasancewa ga maƙalli biyu, sannan ka faɗi ko bayanin da aka bayar ya kayyade dangantakar A da C.
z-m-37-12.material: Ga ƙananan rukunan A, B, C na babban rukuni U={1, 2}, Seojin ya ce: “Idan A⊂B kuma B⊄C, to A⊄C.” Domin gwada ko maganar tana aiki koyaushe, za ka yi amfani da ko maƙallan 1 da 2 suna cikin kowane daga A, B, C (1 idan suna ciki, 0 idan ba sa ciki).
z-m-37-12.thinking.0: Fayyace sharuddan da misali mai karyata iƙirarin dole ne ya cika.
z-m-37-12.thinking.1: Ka ƙirƙiri misalan da ke karyata ta da kanka ta amfani da jadawalin kasancewa cikin rukuni.
z-m-37-12.prereq.1: Ma’anar ƙaramin rukuni A⊂B, da ma’anar A⊄B (A ba ƙaramin rukuni ba ne na B).
z-m-37-12.s.s1.prompt: Domin nuna cewa maganar Seojin ba ta aiki koyaushe, wane irin A, B, C ya kamata ka samo?
z-m-37-12.s.s1.hint.0: Raba maganar Seojin zuwa ɓangarori biyu: “zato” da “ƙarshe”.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi ɓangaren da dole ne ya cika da wanda dole ne a karya.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.a: A, B, C waɗanda suke da A⊂B da B⊄C, sannan A⊂C ma.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.a: Ka nuna misali inda zato ya cika gaba ɗaya amma ƙarshe ƙarya ne.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.b: A, B, C waɗanda suke da A⊂B da B⊂C, sannan A⊄C ma.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.b: Ka karanta zato kamar B⊂C. Zato na Seojin shi ne B⊄C.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.c: A, B, C waɗanda suke da A⊄B da B⊄C, sannan A⊂C ma.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.c: Wannan yana karya ɓangaren farko na zato, saboda haka ba shi da alaƙa da maganar Seojin.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.o.d: A, B, C waɗanda suke da A⊂B da B⊄C, sannan A⊄C ma.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.r.d: Ka samo yanayin da maganar Seojin take aiki. Domin karya maganar, kana bukatar misali inda ƙarshe yake ƙarya.
z-m-37-12.s.s1.explain: Misalin da ke karya “zato yana nufin ƙarshe” shi ne yanayin da zato ya cika gaba ɗaya amma ƙarshe ƙarya ne. A nan wannan shi ne A⊂B, B⊄C, kuma ba A⊄C ba, wato A⊂C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau’ukan (A, B, C) guda 3 dabam-dabam da ke karya maganar Seojin. Shigar da 1 ko 0 ko 1 yana cikin A, B, C (a1, b1, c1), da ko 2 yana ciki (a2, b2, c2).
z-m-37-12.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi maƙalli guda na B da ba ya cikin C. Ka yi tunani ko dole ne wannan maƙalli ya kasance cikin A ma.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.hint.1: Ka sanya kowane maƙalli na A ya kasance a cikin B da C duka.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.fail.k1: Ba kowane maƙalli na A yake cikin B ba. A⊂B ba gaskiya ba ne.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.ok.k2: B⊄C gaskiya ne. B yana da maƙalli da ba ya cikin C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.fail.k2: Kowane maƙalli na B yana cikin C, saboda haka B⊄C ba gaskiya ba ne.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.ok.k3: A⊂C gaskiya ne. Wannan misali ne da ke karya ƙarshe na Seojin.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.fail.k3: A⊄C gaskiya ne. Wannan yanayi ne da maganar Seojin take aiki.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.explain: Misali, A=∅, B={2}, C=∅ yana ba da A⊂B, B⊄C, da A⊂C. A={1}, B={1,2}, C={1} ma yana aiki. Akwai haɗaɗɗun (A, B, C) guda 9 gaba ɗaya da suka cika sharuddan.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta misali guda da ka ƙirƙira a sigar A=…, B=…, C=…, sannan ka bayyana a jimla guda dalilin da ya sa A⊂C zai iya zama gaskiya duk da cewa B⊄C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta A, B, C da ka ƙirƙira a matsayin rukuni, sannan ka nuna wani maƙalli da yake cikin B amma ba ya cikin C.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bincika ko wannan maƙalli yana cikin A.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: A cikin misalina, na bincika kai tsaye cewa A⊂B, B⊄C, da A⊂C duk gaskiya ne?
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na yi amfani da dalilin cewa maƙallin da yake cikin B kaɗai ba ya cikin A?
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Na san cewa yana yiwuwa a sami misali inda A rukuni ne fanko?
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.model.0: Misali: A={1}, B={1,2}, C={1}. A⊂B kuma B⊄C (2 ba ya cikin C), amma A⊂C. Maƙalli 2 na B da ba ya cikin C ba ya cikin A, saboda haka ba shi da alaƙa da A.
z-m-37-12.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan A=∅, B={1}, C={2}, to ∅ ƙaramin rukuni ne na kowane rukuni, saboda haka A⊂C, kuma B⊄C. Dalilin shi ne maƙalli 1 da yake cikin B kaɗai ba shi da alaƙa da A.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.prompt: Daga bayanin “A⊂B kuma B⊄C” kaɗai, me za ka iya tabbatarwa game da dangantakar A da C?
z-m-37-12.s.s3.hint.0: Ka kwatanta misalin da ya karyata maganar da ka riga ka ƙirƙira da wani misali inda A⊄C.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.hint.1: A cikin misalan biyun, ka bincika ko A⊂B da B⊄C duk gaskiya ne.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.o.a: A ba ƙaramin rukuni ba ne na C.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.a: Ka yi tunanin misalan da A⊄C kawai. A cikin misalin da ka ƙirƙira yanzu, A⊂C.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.o.b: A ƙaramin rukuni ne na C.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.b: Ka yi tunanin misalan da A⊂C kawai. Yaya game da misali kamar A={1}, B={1}, C={2}?
z-m-37-12.s.s3.o.c: A da C ba su da wani maƙalli na gama-gari.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.c: Ka mayar da siffar misali guda zuwa ƙa’ida ta gama-gari. Bincika ko A da C suna da wani maƙalli na gama-gari a misalin da ya karyata maganar.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.o.d: Ba a yanke shawarar ko A⊂C ba.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.r.d: Ka lura cewa zato iri ɗaya yana iya ba da sakamako dabam-dabam a wasu misalai.
z-m-37-12.s.s3.explain: Ga A={1}, B={1,2}, C={1}, A⊂C; amma ga A={1}, B={1}, C={2}, A⊂B, B⊄C, kuma A⊄C. Duka sakamakon biyu suna yiwuwa daga wannan bayanin, saboda haka ba a tabbatar da ɗayansu ba.

z-m-37-13.title: Ta yaya “duka aƙalla 60”, “aƙalla ɗaya aƙalla 60”, da “matsakaici aƙalla 60” suke da alaƙa?
z-m-37-13.topic: Dangantakar haɗuwa tsakanin rukunan ɗaliban da suka ci jarrabawa bisa ƙa’idojin cin jarrabawa guda uku.
z-m-37-13.goal: Ka kwatanta rukunin ɗaliban da suka ci bisa ƙa’idojin cin jarrabawa dabam-dabam domin yanke hukunci kan dangantakar haɗuwa, ƙirƙiri wata ƙa’ida guda, sannan ka bayyana dangantakarta da ƙa’idojin da ake da su.
z-m-37-13.material: A cikin aji guda, kana son yanke hukuncin cin ko faɗuwa bisa makin lissafi x da na Turanci y (kowannensu cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 0 zuwa 100) (waɗannan ƙa’idoji na zato ne). Ƙa’ida 1: maki a lissafi da Turanci duka aƙalla 60. Ƙa’ida 2: aƙalla ɗaya daga cikin maki lissafi da Turanci aƙalla 60. Ƙa’ida 3: matsakaicin maki biyun aƙalla 60 (x+y aƙalla 120).
z-m-37-13.thinking.0: Fahimtar cewa ana iya yin kwatanci ko da ba a san rabon makin ba.
z-m-37-13.thinking.1: Nuna da misalan da ke karyata ta cewa haɗuwar tana tafiya ta hanya ɗaya kawai.
z-m-37-13.prereq.1: Rukunin gaskiya na sharadi da dangantakar haɗuwa, ma’anar “da” da “ko”, da ma’anar matsakaici.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.prompt: Ko da yaya aka bayar da makin ajin, wace ƙa’ida ba ta taɓa samun ƙananan ɗalibai da suka ci fiye da sauran ƙa’idoji biyu?
z-m-37-13.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi wasu nau’in makin biyu (misali 70 da 70, 100 da 20, 30 da 30), sannan ka yi jadawalin ko kowane ya ci bisa ƙa’idojin uku.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.hint.1: A cikin jadawalin, duba ko rukunin ɗaliban da suka ci ƙarƙashin wata ƙa’ida ya ƙunshi duk waɗanda suka ci ƙarƙashin wata ƙa’ida.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa “duka biyun” ya fi wahala. Ƙa’idar da sharadinta na cin ya fi tsauri ba za ta iya samun masu cin da yawa ba.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin matsakaici yana tsakanin makin biyun kuma shi ne mafi matsakaici. Ka kwatanta yadda ɗalibi mai babban maki a darasi ɗaya kawai yake yi ƙarƙashin Ƙa’ida 2 da Ƙa’ida 3.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.r.c: Idan aƙalla maki ɗaya ya kai 60, ana cin jarrabawa; saboda haka wannan hukuncin ya fara ne daga tantance nau’in makin da ke cin jarrabawa ƙarƙashin sauran ƙa’idoji.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.o.d: Za a iya sani ne kawai bayan an bayar da makin.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi tunanin ba zai yiwu a kwatanta ba tare da sanin yadda makin suka rarrabu ba. Idan akwai dangantakar haɗuwa tsakanin rukunin waɗanda suka ci, za a iya kwatanta su ko da menene rabon makin.
z-m-37-13.s.s1.explain: Cin Ƙa’ida 1 yana nufin an kuma ci Ƙa’ida 3 da Ƙa’ida 2; cin Ƙa’ida 3 kuma yana nufin an ci Ƙa’ida 2 (idan maki biyun suna ƙasa da 60, matsakaicinsu ma yana ƙasa da 60). Saboda haka rukunin masu cin jarrabawa suna da wannan dangantaka: Ƙa’ida 1 ⊂ Ƙa’ida 3 ⊂ Ƙa’ida 2. Ƙa’ida 2 ce ke tantance mafi ƙarancin masu cin jarrabawa.
z-m-37-13.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau’in makin lissafi x da Turanci y guda biyu dabam-dabam ga ɗaliban da suka ci Ƙa’ida 3 amma ba su ci Ƙa’ida 1 ba. (Nau’in da kawai aka musanya tsarin maki iri ɗaya ne, ba misali dabam ba.)
z-m-37-13.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko, ƙirƙiri makin biyu waɗanda matsakaicinsu daidai yake da 60.
z-m-37-13.s.s2.hint.1: A wannan nau’in, bincika ko makin biyun duka aƙalla 60 ne.
z-m-37-13.s.s2.fail.k0: Dole ne makin su zama cikakkun lambobi daga 0 zuwa 100.
z-m-37-13.s.s2.ok.k1: Matsakaicin maki aƙalla 60 ne (ya ci Ƙa’ida 3).
z-m-37-13.s.s2.fail.k1: Matsakaicin maki bai kai 60 ba. Bai ci Ƙa’ida 3 ba.
z-m-37-13.s.s2.ok.k2: Makin biyun ba duka aƙalla 60 ba ne (bai ci Ƙa’ida 1 ba).
z-m-37-13.s.s2.fail.k2: Makin biyun duka aƙalla 60 ne. Ya ci Ƙa’ida 1.
z-m-37-13.s.s2.explain: Misali: (100, 20) yana da matsakaicin 60, saboda haka ya ci Ƙa’ida 3, amma 20 yana ƙasa da 60, saboda haka bai ci Ƙa’ida 1 ba. (90, 30) da (80, 40) misalai iri ɗaya ne. Saboda haka masu cin Ƙa’ida 3 sun fi masu cin Ƙa’ida 1 yawa (haɗuwar tana tafiya ta hanya ɗaya kawai).
z-m-37-13.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi dalilin da ya dace wanda ya bayyana dalilin da ya sa “ɗalibin da ya ci Ƙa’ida 3 tabbas zai ci Ƙa’ida 2 ma” yake aiki koyaushe.
z-m-37-13.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta zangon da kowane maki biyu yake ciki ga ɗalibin da bai ci Ƙa’ida 2 ba.
z-m-37-13.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo mafi girman ƙimar da x+y zai iya samu a wannan zangon, sannan ka kwatanta da 120.
z-m-37-13.s.s3.o.a: Domin na bincika wasu misalai kamar (100, 20).
z-m-37-13.s.s3.r.a: Ka ce “koyaushe” ne kawai saboda ka bincika misalai. Wasu misalai kaɗan ba su wakiltar dukkan yanayi.
z-m-37-13.s.s3.o.b: Domin idan matsakaicin maki aƙalla 60 ne, makin biyun dole ne su zama aƙalla 60.

z-m-37-02.title: Misalan da ke karyata “x² koyaushe ya fi x girma” nawa ne?
z-m-37-02.topic: Akasin magana da ta fara da “ga kowace lamba ta ainihi x”, da zangon misalan da ke karyata ta.
z-m-37-02.goal: Rubuta akasin magana ta gama-gari (“kowanne ...”) daidai, ƙirƙiri ƙimomi da dama da ke karyata ta, sannan ka taƙaita zangon misalan da ke karyata ta da kalmomi.
z-m-37-02.material: Ka kira magana mai zuwa P. P: “Ga kowace lamba ta ainihi x, x² > x.” (Ana karanta x² > x da cewa “murabba’in x ya fi x girma”.) Yi tunani game da duk lambobin ainihi.
z-m-37-02.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama da ke karyata ta da kanka
z-m-37-02.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ko misali guda ɗaya da ke karyata ta ya wadatar
z-m-37-02.prereq.1: Ma’anar “kowanne” da “akwai” (wanzuwa), da rashin daidaiton quadratic na asali har zuwa warware rashin daidaiton x²≤x.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo ko akwai wurare biyu a jimlar da suke canzawa: kalmomin farko (kowanne/akwai) da alamar rashin daidaito a ƙarshe.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bincika ko x² > x gaskiya ne idan x=0 da kuma idan x=1.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.a: Ga kowace lamba ta ainihi x, x² ≤ x.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.a: Ka bar “kowanne” yadda yake, kuma ka canza alamar rashin daidaito kawai. Ka yi tunani game da yadda “kowanne” yake canzawa idan ka mayar da maganar akasi.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.b: Akwai lamba ta ainihi x wadda x² ≤ x.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.b: Ka canza “kowanne” zuwa “akwai” kuma ka yi daidai da akasin alamar rashin daidaito (> akasinsa ≤ ne).
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.c: Akwai lamba ta ainihi x wadda x² < x.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.c: Ka canza “kowanne” da kyau, amma ka rubuta < a matsayin akasin >. Ka yi tunani inda yanayin x²=x ya shiga.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.o.d: Babu lamba ta ainihi x da x² > x ya cika a kanta.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.r.d: Ka karanta akasin “ga kowace” da cewa “babu ko ɗaya”. Wannan magana ta fi akasi ƙarfi sosai.
z-m-37-02.s.s1.explain: Akasin “ga kowane x, p(x)” shi ne “akwai wani x da ~p(x)”. Akasin x² > x shi ne x² ≤ x (yana haɗa yanayin da suke daidai).
z-m-37-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri lambobin ainihi x guda 3 dabam-dabam da suka cika akasin P, wato misalan da ke karyata P. (Ana iya amfani da ƙimomin goma.)
z-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.0: Saka wasu ƙimomin x tsakanin 0 da 1, sannan ka gani ko ɗaga x zuwa murabba’i yana sa ya fi x girma ko ƙasa da shi.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka 0 da 1 dabam-dabam, sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.2: Saka lamba mara kyau guda ɗaya da kuma lamba da ta fi 1 guda ɗaya, sannan ka kwatanta sakamakon P.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.ok.c1: x² bai fi x ba. Wannan misali ne da ke karyata P.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.fail.c1: x² ya fi x girma. Wannan ƙima ce da P take cika a kanta da gaske. Ka kwatanta murabba’in da x kansa.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.explain: Dukkan lambobin x da suka cika x² ≤ x suna tsakanin 0 da 1. Misali, 0 yana ba da 0 ≤ 0, 1 yana ba da 1 ≤ 1, kuma 0.5 yana ba da 0.25 ≤ 0.5. Akwai misalai marasa iyaka da ke karyata P, amma ko guda ɗaya ma yana sa P ta zama ƙarya.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta a jimla guda zangon lambobin da misalan da ka samo suke ciki, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa za a iya cewa “P ƙarya ce” ko da misali guda ɗaya ne kawai.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Duba inda ƙimomi ukun da ka ƙirƙira suke a kan layin lambobi.
z-m-37-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da yawan ƙimomin da ake bukata domin karya kalmar “kowanne”.

z-m-37-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na yi amfani da yawan misalan da ake bukata domin karya “kowanne” a matsayin dalilina?
z-m-37-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ƙimomi uku nawa suna cikin wannan zangon da gaske?

z-m-37-05.title: Idan 'fom ɗin neman shiga sharadi ne mai muhimmanci', shin miƙa fom ɗin kaɗai ya isa?
z-m-37-05.topic: Fassara sharuddan da ake buƙata da waɗanda suka wadatar (dokokin shiga da sanarwar ƙari)
z-m-37-05.goal: Mayar da jimlolin dokokin yau da kullum zuwa tsarin 'idan ... to ...', sannan duk lokacin da aka ba da sabuwar sanarwa, yanke shawarar ko za ka riƙe ko gyara hukuncinka game da sharadin da ake buƙata ko wanda ya wadatar.
z-m-37-05.material: Ana bayyana sanarwar gasar gabatarwar ƙungiyar makaranta a matakai. Bari m ya zama miƙa fom ɗin shiga, q biya kuɗin shiga, r kuma shiga gasar. (Wannan yanayi na ƙirƙira ne.)

z-m-37-05.s.s1.prompt: Sanarwa ta farko: 'Ƙungiyar da ba ta miƙa fom ɗin shiga ba ba za ta iya shiga gasar ba.' Wace jimla ce wannan idan aka mayar da ita tsarin 'idan ... to ...'?

z-m-37-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ƙungiya guda da ta shiga gasar, sannan ka bincika ko ta miƙa fom ɗin.

z-m-37-05.s.s1.r.a: Sanarwar ba ta cewa duk ƙungiyar da ta miƙa fom ɗin za ta shiga ba. Bincika ko ka juya alkiblar maganar.
z-m-37-05.s.s1.o.b: Idan ƙungiya ba ta miƙa fom ɗin shiga ba, za ta shiga gasar
z-m-37-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka karanta sanarwar a matsayin kishiyarta kai tsaye.
z-m-37-05.s.s1.o.c: Idan ƙungiya ta shiga gasar, ta miƙa fom ɗin shiga
z-m-37-05.s.s1.r.c: Ka samar da kishiyar gaskiya ta 'ƙungiyar da ba ta miƙa fom ba ba za ta iya shiga ba'.
z-m-37-05.s.s1.o.d: Idan ƙungiya ta shiga gasar, ba ta miƙa fom ɗin shiga ba
z-m-37-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka musanta har da ɓangaren da ba kishiyar sakamakon ba ne. Ka yi tunanin ko ƙungiyar da ta shiga ta miƙa fom ɗin ko a'a.

z-m-37-05.s.s2.prompt: Za a bayyana sanarwar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi hukuncinka. Idan za ka iya barin hukuncin baya yadda yake, za ka iya zaɓar haka.
z-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta kowace sanarwa ta amfani da kibiyoyi kamar 'idan p to r', 'idan p da q to r', ko 'akwai ƙungiyoyin da suka shiga r ko da ba q ba'.
z-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ɗaya bayan ɗaya wanne daga cikin kibiyoyin farko ne sabuwar sanarwa ta canza da wanda ba ta canza ba.

z-m-37-05.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Duk ƙungiyoyin da suka miƙa fom ɗin shiga suna shiga gasar

z-m-37-05.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Ka yi la'akari da sabon bayanin cewa akwai ƙungiyoyin da suka shiga ba tare da biyan kuɗin shiga ba.
z-m-37-05.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Biyan kuɗin shiga sharadi ne mai muhimmanci kuma mai wadatarwa don shiga gasar
z-m-37-05.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Ƙungiyoyin da aka ba shawara sun shiga ba tare da biya ba. Za a iya kiransa sharadi mai muhimmanci?
z-m-37-05.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Miƙa fom ɗin shiga ba sharadi ne mai muhimmanci ba kuma

z-m-37-05.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Miƙa fom ɗin shiga har yanzu sharadi ne mai muhimmanci don shiga gasar

z-m-37-01.title: Yaya za mu faɗi “ya karya ƙa’idar”?
z-m-37-01.topic: Akasin sharadin da aka haɗa da “da” (ƙa’idojin amfani da ɗakin motsa jiki)
z-m-37-01.goal: Yi amfani da takamaiman yanayin ɗalibai domin bincika ma’anar karya “p da q”, sannan ka gano ka gyara layin da ya yi kuskure a mafitar da ta rubuta akasin sharadin ba daidai ba.
z-m-37-01.material: Akwai wannan ƙa’ida a ƙofar ɗakin motsa jikin makaranta: “Domin shiga ɗakin motsa jiki, dole ne ka sa takalman cikin gida kuma ka sa alamar suna.” Bari p ya zama “ya sa takalman cikin gida”, q kuma “ya sa alamar suna”. Ƙa’idar tana nufin dole ne a cika duka “p da q”. Yanayin karya ƙa’idar shi ne yanayin da ba “p da q” ba. Jiho ya warware waɗannan “yanayin karya ƙa’ida” kamar haka.

z-m-37-01.thinking.1: Bincika ma’anar akasin magana da takamaiman yanayi
z-m-37-01.thinking.2: Bayyana gyararren furuci ta amfani da yanayi

z-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ɗalibi da yake da ɗaya kawai daga takalman cikin gida da alamar suna, ka tsayar da wannan ɗalibin a ƙofar ɗakin motsa jiki, sannan ka yi la’akari da ko an bi ƙa’idar.

z-m-37-01.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk ɗaliban da ba za su iya shiga ɗakin motsa jiki bisa ƙa’idar ba (waɗanda suka karya ƙa’idar).

z-m-37-01.s.s2.o.a: Ɗalibin da ya sa takalman cikin gida kuma ya sa alamar suna.
z-m-37-01.s.s2.r.a: Wannan ɗalibin ya cika sharuddan biyu. Bincika ko ka saka ɗalibin da ya bi ƙa’idar cikin waɗanda suka karya ta.
z-m-37-01.s.s2.o.b: Ɗalibin da bai sa takalman cikin gida ba amma ya sa alamar suna.

z-m-37-01.s.s2.o.c: Ɗalibin da ya sa takalman cikin gida amma bai sa alamar suna ba.
z-m-37-01.s.s2.r.c: Idan ka bar wannan ɗalibin, za ka rasa cewa rashin ko sharadi ɗaya, wato alamar suna, tuni yana nufin karya ƙa’idar.
z-m-37-01.s.s2.o.d: Ɗalibin da bai sa takalman cikin gida ba kuma bai sa alamar suna ba.
z-m-37-01.s.s2.r.d: Ɗalibin da ya karya sharuddan biyu ma ya karya ƙa’idar. Ka bar wannan ɗalibin a waje.

z-m-37-03.prereq.0: H3 a wannan aiki yana nuna matakin wahala da tallafi ne kawai a jadawalin aikin samarwa, ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta sanya darasin a wannan ajin ba. Ana ɗauka cewa ɗalibin ya fara koyon rukuni da maganganu a makarantar sakandare.
z-m-37-03.title: Idan ka raba “A−(B∪C)”, shin za ka samu rukuni ɗaya?
z-m-37-03.topic: Bincika ko daidaiton rukuni da ya haɗa bambanci da haɗawa yana aiki.
z-m-37-03.goal: Bincika ko daidaiton rukuni daidai ne ta la’akari da yanayi takwas na kasancewar ko rashin kasancewar wani maƙalli, gano furucin da bai dace ba, sannan ka zaɓi waɗanda suka dace.
z-m-37-03.material: Minjun ya yi wannan iƙirari: “Ga rukunan A, B, C, A−(B∪C) = (A−B)∪(A−C) yana aiki koyaushe.” (Ana karanta A−B da “bambancin rukuni A da B”.) Maimakon hoto, kana son bincika ko maƙalli x yana cikin kowane daga A, B, C (1 idan yana ciki, 0 idan ba ya ciki). Akwai yanayi 8, daga (A, B, C) = (0,0,0) zuwa (1,1,1).
z-m-37-03.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci game da daidaito ta amfani da jadawalin kasancewa cikin rukuni
z-m-37-03.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiro yanayin shiga membobinsu da zai zama misali mai karyatawa
z-m-37-03.prereq.1: Ma'anar haɗi, haɗuwa, da bambanci, da ma'anar saiti biyu da suke daidai (kowannensu ƙaramin saiti ne na ɗayan)
z-m-37-03.s.s1.prompt: Idan ka bincika yanayi 8 duka kuma kana son cewa saitunan biyu daidai suke, me dole ne ka tabbatar?
z-m-37-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta ma'anar cewa saituna biyu daidai suke ta amfani da kalmomin 'abu x'.
z-m-37-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin yadda kasancewar yanayi 8 kaɗai ke taimakawa wajen rage adadin bincike.
z-m-37-03.s.s1.o.a: Ya isa idan sakamakon furuci biyun ya yi daidai a yanayi guda ɗaya cikin 8
z-m-37-03.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi ƙoƙarin cewa 'koyaushe' ne bisa daidaituwar yanayi guda. Sauran yanayin fa?
z-m-37-03.s.s1.o.b: Ya isa idan sakamakon ya yi daidai a yanayin da x ba ya cikin B ko C kaɗai
z-m-37-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka bar wani yanayi na musamman ya wakilci dukkan sauran. A wasu yanayi sakamakon na iya bambanta.
z-m-37-03.s.s1.o.c: Ya isa idan saitunan biyu suna da adadin abubuwa iri ɗaya
z-m-37-03.s.s1.r.c: Ko da adadinsu iri ɗaya ne, abubuwan da suka ƙunshi na iya bambanta.
z-m-37-03.s.s1.o.d: Kasancewar x a cikin furucin biyun iri ɗaya ce a duk yanayi 8
z-m-37-03.s.s1.r.d: Ka juya ma'anar saituna daidai, 'kasancewar kowane abu a cikinsu iri ɗaya ce', zuwa yanayi 8.
z-m-37-03.s.s1.explain: Saituna biyu daidai suke idan ga kowane abu x, idan yana cikin wannan gefen yana cikin ɗayan gefen ma. Yanayin kasancewar x guda 8 ne kawai, don haka dole su yi daidai a dukkan 8.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.prompt: Gina yanayin kasancewa (A, B, C) inda x yake cikin A−(B∪C) amma ba ya cikin (A−B)∪(A−C), ko akasin haka, wato sakamakon furuci biyun ya bambanta.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko gina yanayin da x yake cikin ɗaya daga B da C kawai.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.hint.1: A wannan yanayin, bincika ko x yana cikin A−(B∪C), da kuma ko yana cikin A−B ko A−C.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.ok.c0: a, b, c dukkansu 1 ne ko 0.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.fail.c0: a, b, c na iya zama 1 idan yana cikin saiti kawai, 0 kuma idan ba ya ciki.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Furuci biyun sun ba da sakamako dabam ga x.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.fail.c1: A wannan yanayin sakamakon furuci biyun (yana ciki/ba ya ciki) iri ɗaya ne. Gwada yanayin da B da C suka bambanta.
z-m-37-03.s.s2.explain: Idan (A,B,C)=(1,1,0), x yana cikin B, don haka ba ya cikin A−(B∪C), amma yana cikin A−C, saboda haka yana cikin (A−B)∪(A−C). Haka yake ga (1,0,1). Saboda haka wannan daidaito ba ya tabbata.
z-m-37-03.s.s3.prompt: Kana son gyara furucin Minjun domin ya tabbata koyaushe. Zaɓi duk furucin da ke tabbata koyaushe. (Gwada yanayi 8 na kasancewar x.)
z-m-37-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, kwatanta kasancewar x a gefen hagu da na dama a (1,1,0), (1,0,1), (0,0,1).
z-m-37-03.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta yanayin kasancewa guda inda furuci mara daidai ya bayyana kansa, sannan ka kwatanta shi da zaɓuɓɓuka daidai.
z-m-37-03.s.s3.r.a: Bincika ko sakamakon ya bambanta a (1,1,0) ko (1,0,1). Wannan furuci ya sauya dokar musanya haɗuwa da haɗi ta hanyar da ba daidai ba.
z-m-37-03.s.s3.r.b: Ka juya gaskiyar cewa rashin kasancewa cikin B∪C yana nufin ba ya cikin B da C duka zuwa 'da'.
z-m-37-03.s.s3.r.c: Idan ka haɗa dukkan C a gefen dama, abubuwan C da ke wajen A ma za su shiga. Bincika a (0,0,1).
z-m-37-03.s.s3.r.d: Ka juya gaskiyar cewa rashin kasancewa cikin B∩C yana nufin ba ya cikin B ko ba ya cikin C zuwa 'ko'.
z-m-37-03.s.s3.explain: A−(B∪C) shi ne abubuwan da suke cikin A amma ba sa cikin B ko C, saboda haka ya yi daidai da (A−B)∩(A−C). A−(B∩C) shi ne abubuwan A da ba sa cikin B ko ba sa cikin C, don haka ya yi daidai da (A−B)∪(A−C). Dole a musanya alamomin ayyukan.

z-m-37-04.prereq.0: H3 a wannan aiki yana nuna matakin wahala da tallafi ne kawai a jadawalin aikin samarwa, ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta sanya darasin a wannan ajin ba. Ana ɗauka cewa ɗalibin ya fara koyon rukuni da maganganu a makarantar sakandare.
z-m-37-04.title: Wane furuci ne yake faɗin abu ɗaya ne ta wata hanya?
z-m-37-04.topic: Zaɓi furucin saituna da ke da ma'anar 'A ƙaramin saiti ne na B'
z-m-37-04.goal: Zaɓi furucin da ke nufin A⊂B, sannan ka nuna da ƙananan misalai yanayin da furucin da ba daidai ba ya gaza.
z-m-37-04.material: Ga saituna biyu A, B a cikin saitin duniya U, kana son nemo furucin da ke da ma'anar 'A⊂B' (A ƙaramin saiti ne na B). A^c na nufin 'kishiyar A' (saitin da ake samu ta cire abubuwan A daga U). Daga cikin furuci shida da ke ƙasa, waɗanne ne suke da ma'anar A⊂B koyaushe? 'Ma'ana ɗaya' na nufin furucin yana tabbata ne kawai idan A⊂B.
z-m-37-04.thinking.1: Gina misalan da ke karyata furucin da ba ma'ana ɗaya ba
z-m-37-04.prereq.1: Ƙananan saituna; ma'anar haɗi, haɗuwa, bambanci da kishiya (tunanin cikin saitin duniya U); ma'anar saituna biyu daidai
z-m-37-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk furucin da suke daidai da ma'anar A⊂B koyaushe.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.hint.0: Da ƙaramin saitin duniya U={1,2,3}, saita A={1}, B={1,2}, sannan ka bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowane furuci ya tabbata.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ta amfani da hanya ɗaya, sauya zuwa A={1,2}, B={1}, sannan ka kwatanta ko kowane furuci ya tabbata.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.o.a: A∩B=∅ (A da B ba su da abu a haɗe)
z-m-37-04.s.s1.r.a: Ka rikita 'ba sa haɗuwa' da 'yana cikin'. Idan A yana cikin B, A da B suna haɗuwa a zahiri (idan A ba saitin fanko ba ne).
z-m-37-04.s.s1.o.b: A−B=∅ (saitin A an cire B saitin fanko ne)
z-m-37-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka karanta shi da cewa A ba shi da wani abu a wajen B.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.o.c: A∪B=A (haɗin A da B shi ne A)
z-m-37-04.s.s1.r.c: Bincika ko ka karanta 'haɗin ya zama A' da cewa A ya fi B girma. Alkiblar akasin haka ce.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.o.d: A^c⊂B^c (kishiyar A ƙaramin saiti ce na kishiyar B)
z-m-37-04.s.s1.r.d: Ba ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa ɗaukar kishiya yana juya alkiblar kasancewa cikin saiti ba.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.o.e: B^c⊂A^c (kishiyar B ƙaramin saiti ce na kishiyar A)
z-m-37-04.s.s1.r.e: Ka yi amfani daidai da gaskiyar cewa zuwa saitunan kishiya yana juya alkiblar kasancewa cikin saiti.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.o.f: A∩B=A (ɓangaren haɗin A da B shi ne A)
z-m-37-04.s.s1.r.f: Ka karanta 'ɓangaren haɗin duk A ne' da cewa kowane abu na A yana cikin B ma.
z-m-37-04.s.s1.explain: Furucin da suke da ma'anar A⊂B su ne A−B=∅, B^c⊂A^c, A∩B=A, da kuma A∪B=B. A∪B=A yana nufin B⊂A; A^c⊂B^c ma yana nufin B⊂A; A∩B=∅ kuma yana nufin wani abu dabam, cewa A da B ba su da abu ɗaya.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri misali da zai nuna cewa 'A∪B=A' ba shi da ma'anar A⊂B. Saitin duniya U={1,2}; yanke shawarar ko 1 da 2 suna cikin A da B (1/0), sannan ka ƙirƙiri ma'aurata (A, B) daban-daban guda 3 inda A⊂B amma A∪B≠A.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko tabbatar da cewa kowane abu na A yana cikin B ma, sannan ka ƙara abu ɗaya ko fiye da ke cikin B kaɗai.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bincika ko yanayin da A ko B yake saitin fanko shi ma ya cika sharadin.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.fail.c0: Ana iya amfani da 1 idan yana ciki kawai, 0 kuma idan ba ya ciki.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.ok.c1: A⊂B gaskiya ce. Kowane abu na A yana cikin B.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Akwai abu na A da ba ya cikin B. A⊂B ba gaskiya ba ce.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Akwai abu da ke cikin B kaɗai, saboda haka A∪B≠A.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Babu abu da ke cikin B kaɗai. Sai A∪B=A.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.explain: Idan A⊂B kuma A≠B, akwai abu a cikin B kaɗai, saboda haka A∪B=B≠A. Misalai: A={1}, B={1,2}, ko A=∅, B={2}. Ma'aurata 5 ne gaba ɗaya da suka cika wannan sharadi (an cire yanayin A=B, domin a nan A∪B=A=B).
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta a matsayin saiti misali guda inda A⊂B amma A∪B=A bai tabbata ba, sannan ka bayyana irin alaƙar da A da B dole su samu domin A∪B=A.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta misali ɗaya da ka ƙirƙira ta amfani da alamar saiti, sannan ka nemo A∪B da kanka.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rubuta ma'anar cewa A∪B ya yi daidai da A ta amfani da kalmomin 'inda abubuwa suke'.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Na nemo A∪B da kaina ga misalin da na bayar kuwa?
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Na bayyana alaƙar da ke sa A∪B=A bisa wanne daga cikin B da A yake cikin ɗayan kuwa?
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Misalina da gaske ya cika A⊂B kuwa?
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan A={1}, B={1,2}, to A⊂B amma A∪B={1,2}, wanda ya bambanta da A. Domin A∪B=A ta tabbata, dole B⊂A ne.
z-m-37-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan A={2}, B={2,5}, to A∪B={2,5}≠A. A∪B=A yana nufin 'kowane abu na B yana cikin A', saboda haka alkiblar akasin haka ce.

z-m-37-07.title: Shin 'na gwada wasu lambobi ma'aurata kaɗan, kuma ya yi aiki' hujja ce ga wannan ƙa'ida?
z-m-37-07.topic: Tabbatar wa aboki cewa 'idan n² lamba ce mai rabo biyu, to n ma lamba ce mai rabo biyu'
z-m-37-07.goal: Ka tantance wace hanya binciken abokinka ya tabbatar da ita a zahiri, ka zaɓi hanya madaidaiciya don tabbatar da wannan ƙa'ida, sannan ka rubuta ta yadda abokinka zai fahimta.
z-m-37-07.material: Ƙa'ida P game da lambar halitta n ita ce: 'Idan n² lamba ce mai rabo biyu, to n ma lamba ce mai rabo biyu.' Abokinka Hajun ya ce: 'Na gwada n=2, 4, 6, 8. n² su ne 4, 16, 36, 64, duk lambobi masu rabo biyu ne, saboda haka an tabbatar da P.'
z-m-37-07.thinking.1: Zaɓar hanya mafi dacewa daga hanyoyin tabbatarwa da dama

z-m-37-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da suka dace don tabbatar da P. (Ka haɗa hanyar Hajun a cikin hukuncinka.)

z-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta P a tsarin 'idan ... to ...', sannan ka kwatanta abin da yake sharadi da abin da yake ƙarshe a maganar da Hajun ya bincika.
z-m-37-07.s.s1.o.a: Saka wasu ƙimomi kaɗan inda n yake da rabo biyu, sannan ka duba ko n² ma yana da rabo biyu

z-m-37-10.s.s1.o.d: ㄱ gaskiya ne, ㄴ kuma ƙarya ne.
z-m-37-10.s.s1.r.d: Ka bambanta kowane ɗalibi yana da darasin da yake so da kowa yana son darasi ɗaya.
z-m-37-10.s.s1.explain: ㄱ yana nufin kowane ɗalibi yana da aƙalla darasi ɗaya da yake so, don haka gaskiya ne. ㄴ yana nufin akwai darasi ɗaya da dukkan ɗalibai ukun suke so, amma 나 ba ya son Korean, 다 ba ya son lissafi, kuma 가 ba ya son Turanci, saboda haka ƙarya ne.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi mafi kyawun bayanin bambancin ㄱ da ㄴ.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ƙirƙiri yanayi a jadawali inda ㄴ yake gaskiya, sannan ka bincika abin da zai faru da ㄱ a wannan yanayin.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo ko jadawalin da ke sama yana da misali inda ㄱ yake gaskiya amma ㄴ yake ƙarya.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.o.a: ㄱ yana bukatar duk ɗalibai su so darasi ɗaya, amma ㄴ yana yarda darasin ya bambanta ga kowane ɗalibi.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.r.a: Ka juya ma’anar ㄱ da ㄴ. Ka sake kwatanta yadda aka yanke hukunci game da jimlolin biyu a jadawali.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.o.b: ㄴ iƙirari ne mai rauni fiye da ㄱ, don haka idan ㄴ gaskiya ne ba za mu iya sanin ko ㄱ gaskiya ne ba.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.r.b: Idan ㄴ gaskiya ne, akwai darasi guda da kowa yake so, don haka kowane mutum ma yana da darasin da yake so. Ka yi la’akari da wanne iƙirari ya fi ƙarfi.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.o.c: ㄱ yana yarda darasin da ake so ya bambanta ga kowane ɗalibi, amma ㄴ yana bukatar dukkansu su so darasi ɗaya.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.r.c: Ka bambanta ko darasin yana bambanta ga ɗalibai ko iri ɗaya ne, bisa tsarin kalmomin “kowane” da “akwai”.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.o.d: Jimlolin biyu sun bambanta ne kawai a tsarin kalmomi, saboda haka ma’anarsu ɗaya ce.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ya saɓa wa gaskiyar cewa hukuncin da aka yanke a jadawali ya bambanta.
z-m-37-10.s.s2.explain: ㄱ yana yarda kowane ɗalibi ya zaɓi darasi daban (ga kowane ɗalibi akwai wani darasi), amma ㄴ yana bukatar darasi guda ya shafi kowane ɗalibi (akwai darasi da ya shafi kowa). Idan ㄴ gaskiya ne, ㄱ ma gaskiya ne, amma akasin haka ba lallai ba ne.
z-m-37-10.s.s3.prompt: Kana son sa ㄴ ta zama gaskiya ta hanyar canza mafi ƙarancin akwatunan X zuwa O a jadawali. Rubuta aƙalla hanya guda, ka faɗi akwatin darasin da ya shafi wane ɗalibi za ka canza, sannan ka rubuta ko ㄱ har yanzu gaskiya ce bayan canjin.
z-m-37-10.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi darasi guda ka ƙayyade ɗalibai nawa ke da X a wannan darasin.
z-m-37-10.s.s3.hint.1: Bincika ko canza akwatin ɗalibin yana haifar da darasi da kowane ɗalibi yake so.
z-m-37-10.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan ka canza Korean na 나 zuwa O, ...
z-m-37-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Idan na canza akwatin da na zaɓa, duk ɗalibai ukun za su so darasi ɗaya?
z-m-37-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na bincika ko kowane ɗalibi har yanzu yana da darasin da yake so bayan canjin?
z-m-37-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Na yi tunani ko akwai wata hanya ta daban ta canza wani akwati?
z-m-37-10.s.s3.model.0: Idan ka canza akwatin Korean na 나 zuwa O, kowa zai so Korean, saboda haka ㄴ gaskiya ne. ㄱ tuni gaskiya ce kuma mun ƙara O ne kawai, saboda haka har yanzu gaskiya ce.
z-m-37-10.s.s3.model.1: Idan ka canza lissafi na 다 zuwa O, kowa zai so lissafi, saboda haka ㄴ gaskiya ne. Canza Turanci na 가 zuwa O ma yana sa kowa ya so Turanci. A duka yanayin biyu ㄱ har yanzu gaskiya ce.
z-m-37-10.s.s3.model.2: Canza akwatin Korean na ɗalibi 나 zuwa O. Daga nan Korean zai zama O ga kowa, saboda haka ㄴ gaskiya ne kuma ㄱ ma tana nan gaskiya kamar da.

z-m-37-11.prereq.0: H3 a wannan aiki yana nuna matakin wahala da tallafi ne kawai a jadawalin aikin samarwa, ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta sanya darasin a wannan ajin ba. Ana ɗauka cewa ɗalibin ya fara koyon rukuni da maganganu a makarantar sakandare.
z-m-37-11.title: “Dole ne kowane ɗalibi mai tsayin 3 m ko fiye ya nemi izini”: me zai faru idan babu irin wannan ɗalibi?
z-m-37-11.topic: Saitin fanko da gaskiyar magana idan “babu wani maƙalli da ya cika sharadin”.
z-m-37-11.goal: Idan babu maƙalli ko ɗaya da ya cika sharadin, yanke hukunci daga ma’anar ko magana mai sigar “kowane ... shi ne ...” gaskiya ce ko ƙarya, sannan ka bincika shakku da wannan zai iya haifarwa.
z-m-37-11.material: Ƙa’idar makaranta: “Kowane ɗalibi mai tsayin 3 m ko fiye dole ne ya miƙa takardar neman izini.” Babu ko ɗalibi guda mai tsayin 3 m ko fiye a wannan makaranta (wannan yanayi ne na zato). Karanta ƙa’idar da cewa “idan p, to q”, inda p yake nufin “tsawonsa 3 m ko fiye”, q kuma “ya miƙa takardar neman izini”.
z-m-37-11.thinking.0: Nemo abin da ake bukata domin maganar ta zama ƙarya.
z-m-37-11.thinking.1: Yanke hukunci game da yanayin da babu maƙallan da suka dace.
z-m-37-11.thinking.2: Bincika shakku sannan ka sake duba hukuncinka.
z-m-37-11.prereq.1: Lokacin da “idan p, to q” yake ƙarya, da ma’anar rukunin gaskiya da ƙananan rukuni.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.prompt: Domin maganar “ga kowane ɗalibi x, idan p to q” ta zama ƙarya, me dole ne ya kasance?
z-m-37-11.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta a layi guda yadda ɗalibin da ya bi ƙa’idar da wanda ya karya ta kowannensu yake.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.hint.1: Ka ɗauka akwai ɗalibi da ya karya ƙa’idar, sannan ka rubuta yanayin da dole ne ɗalibin yake ciki ga p da q.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.o.a: Babu ko ɗalibi guda da yake p.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauki rashin ɗaliban da suka dace a matsayin dalilin ƙarya. Ka yi tunani ko wane irin ɗalibi ne zai “karya ƙa’idar” har ta zama ƙarya.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.o.b: Akwai ɗalibi da yake p amma ba q ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.r.b: Ka nuna ainihin ɗalibin da ya karya ƙa’idar, wato misalin da ke karyata ta.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.o.c: Akwai ɗalibi da ba p ba kuma ba q ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.r.c: Ɗalibin da ba p ba ba ya cikin abin da ƙa’idar take magana a kansa.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.o.d: Babu ko ɗalibi guda da yake q.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.r.d: Rashin ɗalibin da ya cika q bai saɓa wa rashin wanda yake p ba. Matsala ita ce kawai ɗalibin da yake p amma bai yi q ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s1.explain: “Idan p, to q” tana zama ƙarya ne kawai idan akwai ɗalibi (misali da ke karyata maganar) da ya cika p amma bai cika q ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.prompt: Za a bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki ka zaɓi hukuncinka. Idan hukuncin baya har yanzu yana da ma’ana, za ka iya ci gaba da shi.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fara gwada ko za ka iya gano ko da ɗalibi guda ɗaya da ya karya ƙa’idar.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta ƙa’idar kowane mataki a sigar “P⊂Q” ko “P⊂ cikawar Q”, sannan ka bincika maƙallan P ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.info: Bayani 1: Babu ko ɗalibi guda mai tsayin 3 m ko fiye a wannan makaranta. Ƙa’ida: Kowane ɗalibi mai tsayin 3 m ko fiye dole ne ya miƙa takardar neman izini.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.ask: Akwai ɗalibi da ya karya wannan ƙa’idar?
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.after: Babu wanda ya karya ta. Domin ƙa’idar ta zama ƙarya, dole ne a sami ɗalibi mai p amma ba q ba; amma babu ɗalibi mai p, don haka babu irin wannan ɗalibi.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Babu ɗalibin da ya karya ta.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Ka yi amfani da abin da ka tabbatar a s1: dole ne a sami ɗalibi da ya karya ta (misali mai karyatawa) domin ta zama ƙarya.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Babu ɗaliban da suka dace, saboda haka ba za ka iya bincika ko akwai wanda ya karya ta ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Ka ɗauki “babu abin da za a bincika” da “babu ɗalibin da ya karya ta” a matsayin abu ɗaya. A zahiri, ka tabbatar da cewa babu irin wannan ɗalibi.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Akwai. Keta ƙa’idar shi ne ɗalibi mai tsayin 3 m ko fiye bai taɓa miƙa takardar neman izini ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Ka ɗauki gaskiyar cewa babu ɗalibai a matsayin keta ƙa’ida. Keta ƙa’ida gaskiya ce game da wani ɗalibi.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.o.d: Ba a yi amfani da ƙa’idar ga kowane ɗalibi ba, saboda haka ba ƙa’ida ba ce.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.0.r.d: Ka auna tasirin ƙa’idar bisa ko akwai wanda za a yi wa ita. Ana kuma ƙirƙirar ƙa’ida ne domin lokacin da irin waɗannan mutane suka bayyana.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.info: Bayani 2: A lissafi ana rubuta wannan ƙa’ida da P⊂Q. P shi ne rukunin ɗalibai masu tsayin 3 m ko fiye, Q kuma rukunin ɗaliban da suka miƙa takardar neman izini. A nan P rukuni ne fanko.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.ask: Yaya za ka yanke hukunci game da rukuni fanko ∅⊂Q?
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.after: Babu wani maƙalli na P da ya ɓace daga Q, saboda haka P⊂Q. ∅⊂Q gaskiya ne ga kowane rukuni Q.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Ƙarya ne. Babu maƙalli, don haka ba za a kira shi ƙaramin rukuni na Q ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin dole ne rukuni ya ƙunshi maƙalli domin ya zama ƙaramin rukuni. Ma’anar ƙaramin rukuni ita ce “kowane maƙalli na P yana cikin Q”.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Gaskiya ne. Babu ko maƙalli guda na P da yake wajen Q.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Ka yi amfani da ma’anar ƙaramin rukuni yadda take. Wannan yana kama da Bayani 1 domin babu keta ƙa’ida (misali mai karyatawa).
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Gaskiya ne ne kawai idan Q ma rukuni ne fanko.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Ka ɗauka hukuncin ya danganta da ko Q yana da maƙalli. Idan P ba shi da maƙalli, ko yaya Q yake, babu maƙalli da ya karya sharadin.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.o.d: Wannan kawai wata yarjejeniya ce ta ma’ana, ba ta da dalili.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.1.r.d: Ba yarjejeniya ba ce, sakamakon amfani da ma’anar ne. Za ka iya bayyana dalilin: babu misali da ke karyata ta.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.info: Bayani 3: Wannan makarantar tana da wata ƙa’ida kuma: “Babu ɗalibi mai tsayin 3 m ko fiye da zai iya miƙa takardar neman izini.”
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.ask: Ka ce ƙa’idojin biyu gaskiya ne. Shin wannan saɓani ne?
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.after: Idan babu ɗaliban da suka dace, ƙa’idojin biyu gaskiya ne. Idan ko ɗalibi guda mai dacewa ya kasance, to wannan ɗalibin ko dai ya miƙa takardar neman izini ko bai miƙa ba; saboda haka ƙa’idojin biyu ba za su iya zama gaskiya lokaci guda ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Saɓani ne. Dole ne ɗaya daga cikinsu ya zama ƙarya.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Ka ɗauki “ya miƙa takardar neman izini” da “bai miƙa ba” a matsayin kishiyoyi, saboda haka ba za su iya zama gaskiya tare ba. Ka yi tunani ko akwai ɗaliban da suka dace.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Ba saɓani ba ne. Babu ɗaliban da suka dace, don haka babu ɗalibin da ya karya ko wace ƙa’ida.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Ka tabbatar cewa babu ɗalibin da ya karya kowace ƙa’ida (babu misali mai karyatawa).
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Idan ko ɗalibi guda mai dacewa ya bayyana, ƙa’idojin biyu ba za su iya zama gaskiya tare ba.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Ka nuna ainihin inda tunanin saɓani yake fitowa: lokacin da ɗalibi mai dacewa ya bayyana.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Ƙa’ida ta farko ce kawai gaskiya, ta biyu kuma ƙarya.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.st.2.r.d: Ka yanke hukuncin cewa ƙa’ida ta biyu ƙarya ce ba tare da neman misali mai karyatawa ba. Bincika ko akwai irin wannan misali.
z-m-37-11.s.s2.reflect: Idan da farko ka ji cewa “babu abin da za a bincika”, ta yaya hukuncinka ya canza yayin da ka yi tunani game da ma’anar misali mai karyatawa? Me ya sa zai iya zama abin mamaki cewa ƙa’idojin biyu gaskiya ne tare?
